svg.title: Transient overload under rate-monotonic scheduling (Buttazzo 2005 counterexample)
svg.desc: Gantt chart over 60 half-milliseconds. Task t1 overruns in its first two jobs. The task that misses its deadline is t2, not the longest-period task t4.
svg.text: tick up-arrow = release dashed tick = deadline X = deadline missed (time unit = 0.5 ms)
